purpose: Known case-12 regression and natural language usability probes; one previously viewed source group, not independent tests.
reviewer: Codex direct visual review; AI-assisted, not human

observations.brown: A coherent brown sepia palette is now visible and scene layout remains. This depends on the additional sepia editor tool as well as the trained model choosing it.
observations.warm_cool_pair: Opposite requests produce visibly opposite temperature changes.
observations.shadows: Dark vegetation becomes moderately more visible while the cloud structure remains.
observations.saturation_pair: Increasing and decreasing saturation visibly move in opposite directions.
observations.strength_failure: Slightly richer and much more vibrant produce exactly identical saturation 25 and identical output pixels in both candidates; relative strength discrimination failed.
observations.compound_failure_current: Warm slightly and reduce saturation returns only temperature 25; the visible green remains rich. The second clause is omitted.
observations.compound_base: Base-start candidate returns temperature 25 and saturation -20; executable two-clause output, not a multi-image generalization result.

conclusion: Improved basic global tool selection; high practical usefulness not established. Do not continue training only fixed-amplitude templates.
